message.content:
I see. The vulnerability is an integer overflow in `mg_http_parse`. When `Content-Length` is set to a huge value, `hm->message.len = (size_t) req_len + hm->body.len;` can overflow. The fix adds `if (hm->message.len < (size_t) req_len) return -1;`.

Let me look at the full `mg_http_parse` function to understand the flow and how the overflow leads to a memory-safety issue. Let me look at lines 232-300.
